name: repo-flow-atlas
content_review: Reusable viewer, source grouping helpers and fictional parcel-event fixture only. No company datasets, screenshots, schemas, message routes, repository names or business-source excerpts included.

script_review.network: No network requests in bundled Python scripts or viewer.
script_review.execution: No project execution, shell subprocess, dependency installation, authentication or publishing in bundled helpers.
script_review.reads: Only manifest-named source files inside explicit repository roots; traversal and escaping symlinks rejected.
script_review.writes: Explicit output directory; no overwrite of nonempty output without explicit flag.
script_review.credentials: Denylist blocks credential/environment/log/database/private-key paths. The scanner matches three of those denial strings as PE3 findings.
script_review.dependencies: Python >=3.9 standard library for build; Playwright+Chromium optional for browser verification; no credentials needed.

scanner_interpretation: 100% of bundled files inspected statically, but result remains partial and has three high-severity PE3 matches on denylist literals. The partial reference is Bash in the declared allowed-tools list. No baseline suppression or guard removal was used.

baseline.result: Baseline artifact provided explanations and arguments but invented a different article/list layout, had no SVG/Excalidraw export and did not run browser checks. Bundled viewer and explicit visual/data contract address that presentation variance.
baseline.behavioral_test_state: Independent forward evaluation was attempted but could not finish because the evaluator hit an account usage limit. Deterministic runtime and browser checks passed.

runtime_tests: 6 passed, including multiline grouping, callback structure, source boundaries, export bindings, non-Java source equality and required explanations.
browser_tests: Fictional sample navigation, inspectors, statement reader, dark code and lazy function index passed.
